title_internal: 3 steps to stop translating in your head

rewatch_engineering.loop_trick: Three-icon row (eye/hand/brain) appears in the same composition at 0:02 and 0:33; the loop wraps cleanly
rewatch_engineering.hidden_detail: Tiny stopwatch in upper-right counts 00:00 -> 03:00 across the whole Short - mirrors the actual drill duration. Viewers spot it on watch #2 and feel like the Short itself was the drill
rewatch_engineering.punchline_reveal: Opens 'Your brain is broken'. Closes 'Your brain isn't broken. It just needs new wiring.' Same brain, opposite verdict
rewatch_engineering.info_density: 3 drills + frequency + duration + result + scientific framing in 35s. Viewers scrub back to extract the protocol
rewatch_engineering.visual_rhythm: Each drill name lands on a kick drum. Caption pops on the same beat

beats.visual: Animated brain glitching - text fragments scatter. Hidden stopwatch in upper-right reads 00:00
beats.caption: Your brain is BROKEN.
beats.voice_line: Your English brain is broken. Three minutes a day fixes it.

beats.visual: Three icons slide in from left: eye, hand, brain-with-image. Sticky bar at bottom: '3 drills | 1 min each | 14 days'
beats.caption: 3 DRILLS | 1 MIN EACH | 14 DAYS
beats.audio: kick drum x3 on icon entrances
beats.voice_line: Three drills. One minute each. Fourteen days.

beats.visual: POV walking through room; objects highlighted with English label as they're named (cup, lamp, book, plant)
beats.caption: STEP 1 | OBJECT NAMING
beats.audio: soft footsteps, label chime on each highlight
beats.voice_line: Step one. Object Naming. Walk through a room. Name every object out loud. In English. Just the noun.

beats.visual: POV cooking + walking + brushing teeth quick montage; verb labels appear ('cooking', 'walking', 'brushing')
beats.caption: STEP 2 | VERB MAPPING
beats.audio: ambient kitchen + street + bathroom quick cuts
beats.voice_line: Step two. Verb Mapping. Walking, cooking, brushing. Narrate the action in present tense. Out loud. In English.

beats.visual: Two side-by-side panels: left shows English text being translated to native language (slow, frustrated). Right shows same English being pictured as an image (fast, calm)
beats.caption: STEP 3 | IMAGE REPLACEMENT
beats.voice_line: Step three. Image Replacement. When someone speaks to you, do not translate. Picture what they said.

beats.visual: Stopwatch hits 03:00. Calendar pages blur 14 days. Brain animation stops glitching, stabilizes, starts glowing gold
beats.caption: 3 MIN/DAY | 14 DAYS | DONE
beats.voice_line: Three minutes a day. Fourteen days. Translation habit dies.

beats.visual: Brain in full gold glow, stable
beats.caption: Your brain isn't BROKEN. | It needs NEW wiring.
beats.voice_line: Your brain isn't broken. It just needs new wiring.

beats.visual: Three icons return to the same composition as 0:02 (loop trick). Hidden stopwatch reads 03:00
beats.caption: 3 MIN. 14 DAYS.
